films.title: Border Run
films.overview: A female American reporter searches for her missing brother against the backdrop of violence and human smuggling across the US/Mexican border.

films.title: Christmas with You
films.overview: Feeling career burnout, pop star Angelina escapes to grant a young fan's wish in small-town New York, where she not only finds the inspiration to revitalize her career but also a shot at true love.

films.title: Ladies' Night
films.overview: Two girls find love in the most unexpected places in modern-day Mexico City.

films.title: How to Break Up with Your Douchebag
films.overview: This comedy takes its cue from such female-centered films as "Bridesmaids" and "Trainwreck." Pic centers on a woman who makes a living from breaking up couples and decides to take on the task of splitting up her sister's relationship with her jerk of a boyfriend.

films.title: Despite Everything
films.overview: Sara, Lucía, Sofía and Claudia are sisters, 4 modern women with very different personalities, who come together at their mother's funeral, after which they discover the man they've all called "dad" throughout their lives is not really their father. They embark on a quest to discover who their real fathers are, discovering more about themselves, their mother, and their lives.
